entities.summary: Marie Laurencin was a French painter and printmaker. She became an important figure in the Parisian avant-garde as a member of the Cubists associated with the Section d'Or. Marie Laurencin was a authors & novelists from 10ᵗʰ arrondissement of Paris (1883-10-31, 10ᵗʰ arrondissement of Paris–1956-06-08). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
